The retail E20 specification is IS 17021:2018, which was not retrieved; IS 17943's foreword says it is derived from IS 17021 with closer tolerances. entries.source: coleman2012_us8268629, col. 10, lines 36-50; the patent cites french2005 for the underlying phase-equilibrium data
entries.label: LITERATURE VALUE
entries.note: The patent does not state the fitted range of ethanol content or temperature. Cross-checks: (1) at E10, 15.6 °C it gives 0.63 wt %, about 0.47 % v/v, consistent with 0.5 % v/v at 60 °F in korotney1995 Fig. 1; (2) at 25 % v/v ethanol, 0 °C it gives 1.93 wt % vs 1.78-1.88 % mass measured by haq1990 (p. 352-353). Real tolerance also depends on aromatics and other oxygenates (gramajo2004), which this correlation ignores.

entries.label: ASSUMPTION
entries.note: Liquid water entering the tank settles to the bottom (denser than fuel) and dissolves through the interface at a finite rate. Vapour taken up by breathing goes straight into solution. A real value needs interface mass-transfer measurements; it controls how much a drain-out can remove before the water dissolves.
